text.zh-TW: 確認申根區停留天數的算法與這趟會不會超過
text.en: Confirm how Schengen days are counted and that this trip stays within them

text.zh-TW: 確認歐洲旅遊資訊暨授權系統（ETIAS）目前是否需要申請
text.en: Confirm whether ETIAS (European Travel Information and Authorisation System) is required yet

text.zh-TW: 確認火車通行證和點對點票哪個划算
text.en: Confirm whether a rail pass or point-to-point tickets work out cheaper

text.zh-TW: 確認哪些車次要訂座、通行證要不要先啟用
text.en: Confirm which trains need seat reservations and when to activate the pass

text.zh-TW: 確認各城市的住宿城市稅與付款方式
text.en: Confirm each city's tourist tax and how it is paid

text.zh-TW: 確認博物館是否預約制、休館日
text.en: Confirm which museums need timed entry and their closing days

text.zh-TW: 確認會用到的幣別（EUR 以外如 CHF、CZK、GBP）
text.en: Confirm the currencies you will need (CHF, CZK, GBP besides EUR)

text.zh-TW: 確認週日商店是否休息，補給要提前
text.en: Confirm whether shops close on Sundays and stock up beforehand

text.zh-TW: 確認車站與觀光區的扒手防範
text.en: Confirm how to guard against pickpockets at stations and sights

text.zh-TW: 能自己扛上樓梯的行李
text.en: Luggage you can carry up stairs
